notes: Fixes the install failure in 3.0.0. If 3.0.0 refused to install with a "MissingBundleExecutable" error, that was a packaging bug on my end — not your signing setup. The Live Activity extension shipped without declaring its executable, so iOS rejected the app before signing came into it. Same features as 3.0.0: light mode, the new home screen with no bottom sheet, Live Activity on the Lock Screen and Dynamic Island, Walk/Drive here from your real location, map style swatches, full-screen Places, km/h and mph, speed changes while moving.
